verses.1: A song of praise for David.
verses.2: May God bless you with peace in Zion, and may You be filled with joy.
verses.3: Hearing the prayer is more important than all other words.
verses.4: The words of those who sinned against me have become my sins. You shall forgive them.
verses.5: May you choose and come near. May your courtyard be filled with blessings. Your house shall be holy, your dwelling place shall be sanctified.
verses.6: May they be saved by righteousness. May the God who saves us be our refuge from all the laws of the earth and from distant seas.
verses.7: The mountains are prepared by their strength; they stand firm in their greatness.
verses.8: They will be like waves of water, with their currents and movements. They will also become like gods.
verses.9: And the inhabitants of the borders were afraid of your stars, morning and evening.
verses.10: You have made the earth barren and it has become extremely dry. Prepare for God’s judgment; it will come soon. Prepare the fish, for that is what will be needed.
verses.11: Let her be blessed; let her have many children. May she grow up healthy and strong. Blessed be she!
verses.12: May your good years be filled with joy, and may your celebrations be filled with happiness.
verses.13: Winds blew from the desert, and the trees and shrubs were in bloom.
verses.14: The trees will be cut down, and the hills will be covered with thorns. They will be destroyed completely.
